method: console convars read from the running game
cl_showpos steady-state runs on a flat upper-tunnel segment
weapon max speeds cross-checked with scripts/weapons.vdata_c
uncertainty: Single steady-state run per condition; cl_showpos rounds to 0.01. Repeat with demo tick data before treating times as calibrated.
notes: Weapon max speed is taken from scripts/weapons.vdata_c.
Walk/crouch modifiers are measured as 111.8/215 and 73.1/215.
sv_maxspeed is a server cap; weapon max speed is lower for all measured weapons.
Do not use a fixed crouch speed of 85 for all weapons: 85 is knife 250 * 0.34.
